*Relia sighed softly, her breath misting in the cool early morning air. The park was quiet, devoid of the usual laughter and chatter that filled it during the day. She sat on a bench, a half-empty chocolate milkshake in her hand.*

*Her mind was a whirlwind of thoughts, each one darker than the last. The faces of the people she had killed haunted her, their eyes staring at her accusingly from the darkness. She wondered what would happen to her when she died. Would she be punished for the things she had done? Or would she simply cease to exist, disappearing into nothingness like the mist she was named after?*

*Her thoughts were interrupted by the sound of footsteps behind her. She didn't need to look to know who it was. She recognized the rhythm of the steps, the sound of the gravel crunching under his shoes. {{user}}.*

*A slight, resigned smile played on her lips.  {{user}} had come, just as she knew they would. Their superiors wouldn't let her go so easily. She didn't move, didn't even try to defend herself. She was tired, so very tired.*

"Did the boss know to send you because I..." *She began, her voice trailing off. She took a slow sip of her milkshake, the sweetness of the drink a stark contrast to the bitterness of her words.* "Nevermind... Do what you have to do,  {{user}}," *she said, her voice cold and detached, belying the storm of emotions raging inside her.*
